name: Unearthed Pools cuts Unmake's cast time and instant mana costs natively (#2181)
contract: Spell.dbc gives Unearthed Pools 574309 two self-targeted APPLY_AURA effects. Effect 0 is aura 357 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_INSTANT_MANA_COST_PCT, EffectBasePoints 9 with DieSides 1 -> 10; SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost subtracts it from powerCostMultiplier for POWER_MANA spells that are not channeled and whose CastTimeEntry->CastTime is 0, then applies powerCost = int32(powerCost * (1.0f + powerCostMultiplier)), i.e. a flat 10% cut on intrinsically instant mana spells. Effect 1 is aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), EffectBasePoints -16 with DieSides 1 -> -15, EffectSpellClassMask [32, 33554432, 0]; word 1 bit 25 is Unmake and word 0 bit 5 is Artificer's Wand, the two arms of the tooltip's $?s804478 conditional. The tooltip reads 'Reduces the cast time of Unmake by -15% and reduces the mana cost of your instant spells by 10%'. Fixtures: Unmake 503784 has SpellFamilyFlags word 1 bit 25, CastingTimeIndex 16 = 1500 ms, DmgClass 1 (magic, so Unit::ModSpellCastTime multiplies by UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED, which is 1.0 for an unhasted fixture) and no SPELL_ATTR0_USES_RANGED_SLOT, so 1500 ms becomes 1275 ms. Timerend 801291 is the instant mana control: CastingTimeIndex 1 = 0 ms, PowerType 0, ManaCostPercentage 17, and SpellFamilyFlags word 1 bit 24, which is OUTSIDE the cast-time class mask - so its power cost must drop 10% while its SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME modifier must stay untouched. All metrics here are native queries; no cast is submitted. No script or SQL is needed; this is a regression scenario for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Learning the passive applies its aura
Instant mana cost reduction resolves to 10
Unmake's cast time is 0.85 of its unmodified value
Timerend, an instant mana spell, costs 10% less
The cast-time cut does not reach Timerend, which is outside the class mask
